Event Start

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	WorkWithLink.Link = BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWW.Link()

	For each vw_CuentaCorrView
		where vw_CC_Id = &vw_CC_Id
		Form.Caption = vw_CC_Empresa.ToString()
		&Exists = True

	When none
		Form.Caption = "WWP_RecordNotFound"
		&Exists = False
	Endfor

	If (&Exists)
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tabs.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'LoadTabs'
	Endif

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event Load

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event Tabs.TabChanged

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&SelectedTabCode = Tabs.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'LoadTabs'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Sub 'LoadTabs'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If &LoadAllTabs OR &SelectedTabCode = '' OR &SelectedTabCode = !"General"
		GeneralWC.Object = vw_CuentaCorr_testGeneral.Create(&vw_CC_Id)
	EndIf
	If &LoadAllTabs OR &SelectedTabCode = !"vw_CuentaCorr"
		vw_CuentaCorrWC.Object = vw_CuentaCorr_testvw_CuentaCorr.Create(&vw_CC_Id)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
